info.description: 7-day meal plan prescribed by a dietitian for a client profile

clientProfile.description: The client profile this meal plan is prescribed for (N:1)

dietitian.description: The dietitian who created/owns this meal plan

weekStartDate.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) marking the Monday of the plan week

scheduledSlots.description: JSON map: { [DayOfWeek]: { [OccasionType]: RecipeId } } — up to 42 addressable slots

cumulativeDailyGL.description: JSON map: { [DayOfWeek]: number } — daily cumulative Glycemic Load totals

cumulativeDailyNetCarbs.description: JSON map: { [DayOfWeek]: number } — daily cumulative net carbohydrate totals

status.description: Plan lifecycle: only one 'active' plan per client at a time

sharingScope.description: Asset visibility: PRIVATE to client or CLINIC_SHARED across practice dietitians
